requirements.requiredInput: 53 source registrations now have distinct identity-only canonical entries. Bodens BK source registration 1577093 still needs senior/reserve identification. District squads, eligibility and sporting results are separate prerequisites.
Completed simulated district standings and supported qualification results using eligible registered canonical clubs. Published current tables are not future final results.
Explicit reference entrant or organizer ruling for H1N-10 versus H2Ö-2. General B-H-H text does not choose the reference entrant.
Organizer-approved allocation after sporting outcomes, based on national travel geography; district destinations for relegated clubs. Current groups are not next-season allocations.
Season-specific entry acceptance, HBL licence and dated cooperation/B-team decisions for each affected club. No blanket eligible default.
Verified 2027/28 sporting rules and kickoff/calendar profile. Confirmed fees do not establish league structure or match dates.
Supported canonical squad/registration coverage for district match simulation. Identity-only catalog entries do not create players, ratings or completed district matches.

notes: Registration snapshots are as of review date, not retroactive July career membership or qualification entrants.
HF Mitt May page says 12 teams but lists 11; review-date Profixio lists 10 with 18 matches each. No twelfth club or withdrawal ruling inferred.
Source registrations are kept separate from canonical club identities. Bodens BK reserve identity, Tumba HK versus IFK Tumba HK, and HF Karlskrona U versus senior club must be reviewed separately.
No 2027/28 official league package was found on current handbook/calendar publications. Future cup registration is not league profile evidence.
